title: The Small Vow Again
author: R. M. Zhou
blurb: Odile Ashgrove, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must forgive the person in the mirror first before the bakery lease runs out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
